captions.linkedin:
Planning December cash? Set your payment dates around the National Day holiday now, before the year-end close leaves no room to move them.

The UAE government portal lists the National Day public holiday as 2 and 3 December, for the public and private sectors (u.ae, page updated 29 Oct 2026; checked 12 Nov 2026). Confirm against the official 2026 announcement before you move payment dates.

Who it affects: any business with payments due in early December.

What we'd look at this week:
• The payroll date and the bank's processing cut-off
• Supplier runs falling on 2–3 December, and loan due dates confirmed with the bank
• A cash buffer for receipts that arrive later than planned
